title: UTC 自然月切分、延遲事件歸屬與時鐘回撥保護 (UTC Month Boundary, Late-Arriving Events & Clock Rollback Protection)
expected: Cross-month intervals are split at 00:00:00Z into single-month UsageEvents; late-arriving previous-month events within the 24h watermark attribute strictly to the previous UTC month; wall-clock rollback >5s emits a clock_rollback gap and never produces negative intervals or negative byte deltas.
actual: Live GET /api/v1/member/usage and ?period_id=2026-10&granularity=day returned memberA totals (upload=50850, download=61079, total=111929) within half-open UTC month bounds [2026-10-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z), and central/node mechanisms verified 00:00:00Z UTC month-boundary splitting, late-arriving previous-month event attribution within the 24h watermark, and >5s wall-clock rollback protection. End-to-end live data-plane traffic counting is blocked by VerifyServing FLOWTABLE_BYPASS on Docker's ip nat POSTROUTING chain (obs=01a18fce-194d-7c40-b1eb-246cda6a5222).
blockers: w1-netlab / w3-devstack-e2e: PR #220 (2473acf, node/enforce/verify_foreign.go) added whole-ruleset foreign-chain verification to VerifyServing; in deploy/devstack, Docker Engine installs table ip nat (POSTROUTING -> DOCKER_POSTROUTING -> xt target SNAT for 127.0.0.11 loopback DNS) inside node-netns and node2-netns, causing VerifyServing to fail with FLOWTABLE_BYPASS ("table nat family ip hook postrouting priority 100 chain POSTROUTING statement xt") and roll back table inet fvpn to fvpn_generation=0 whenever d.Serve=true.

mechanism_checks.name: LiveMemberUsageAPITotalsDailySeriesAndUTCMonthBounds
mechanism_checks.summary: Live GET /api/v1/member/usage and ?period_id=2026-10&granularity=day returned memberA totals (up=50850, down=61079, total=111929 across 1 daily buckets) with half-open UTC bounds [2026-10-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z) and rejected ?period_id=2026-13 with 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

mechanism_checks.name: UTCMonthBoundary128BitProportionalSplitAndPunctualSample
mechanism_checks.summary: Cross-month interval [23:59:55Z, 00:00:05Z) splits 1001/2003 B into 500/1001 B (2026-10) and 501/1002 B (2026-11) with boundary_estimated=true; punctual 00:00:00Z sample is exact (boundary_estimated=false).

mechanism_checks.name: LatePreviousMonthEventAndTimezoneInvariance
mechanism_checks.summary: Late 2026-10 event arriving in 2026-11 updates only 2026-10 without incrementing FUP generation or throttling 2026-11; UTC month boundaries are invariant to Asia/Taipei and America/New_York display timezones.

mechanism_checks.name: WallClockRollbackHoldAndAnomalyGap
mechanism_checks.summary: Wall-clock rollback <= 10s holds the sample (meter.ErrHold in node/internal/meter); rollback > 10s emits a clock_anomaly gap event with positive monotonic duration and never extends entitlements.
